owner_section.heading: Meet Patrick and Rick
owner_section.body:
Let It Roll is Patrick and Rick. When you call, you talk to one of them, and they're the ones doing the painting.

High and cathedral ceilings are what they're known for, along with drywall repair and popcorn ceiling removal, for homes and businesses.

faqs.q: Do you paint high and cathedral ceilings?
faqs.a: Yes. Cathedral and high-ceiling rooms are our specialty.
